Kwame, I posted the answer in #coastal-team. The official date PHL changed hands to you is November 3, 2025.

Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2 says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's cutover recap note says the same. That note also says she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21 and that you fully took over on Nov 22. I told Kwame to use Nov 3 in the CRM and to treat Nov 22 as the day-to-day takeover date, if he wants to note it.
